audience: People who want to build a regular language-learning habit
brief: Show an actual lesson and a visible learning path. Emphasize small daily actions rather than promising a fluency outcome.

facts.text: Duolingo organizes language study into bite-sized lessons.
Language lessons include speaking, writing, reading and listening exercises.
Personalized practice reviews course content and mistakes made by the learner.

sources.title: How to Use Duolingo for Language Learning

assetSources.capture: Official course-selection and exercise screenshots, with source image URL retained when ingested
Press page requires a browser; no asset download or license verified yet

notes: No pass rate, fluency deadline, university equivalence, user-count or subscription-price claims. Screenshots and characters remain Duolingo materials, not repository-owned assets.

confirmation.allowedUse: Official-source product features and course contents only; no invented outcomes; no public renders.
